name: Dependency update
purpose: Upgrade packages with vulnerability, compatibility and license checks.
trigger: An advisory, scheduled update or end-of-life notice affects a dependency.
entry_criteria: Dependency manifests and lockfiles are current in the repository

steps.note: Approval needed only for a license exception.

decisions.question: Does a new dependency violate license policy?

failure_paths.action: Pin to the last good version or fix the incompatibility; record the reason

exit_criteria: No new critical or high advisory
License policy satisfied or exception approved
Full regression passes on updated lockfile
communication_plan: Note breaking changes in the release notes.
